complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/falsifiable-instruments/RESULTS.md is the narrative ledger, with channels/ADVERSARIAL.md and three per-goal RESULT files beside it. WHAT THE MACHINE-CHECKED CORE ABOVE CANNOT EXPRESS. The close reports `direction=zero (vs FI-05)` and `max_state_space_bound OVER CAP at 111.1%`. Both are inherited: FI-06 changed no model, no adapter and no production file, and the bound was already over the cap at FI-05. The bound is also a LOWER bound -- the product over 7 of 9 declared variables, with `lastCommand` and `result` unresolved -- and this ticket did not resolve them, because doing so would be a change made during a measurement. THE FIGURE THIS TICKET DID RECORD, AND IT IS NOT THIS ONE. FI-06's produced-code descriptor figures over the three judged arms sit in the mechanical block of RESULTS.md section 2 and are NEVER SCORED (thermometer_rule; MF-020: a metric falling is not evidence a design improved). They disagree with D2, which by the card's own scoring rule 7 is a finding and is filed as FI-06-DF-05: the arms separate by an order of magnitude on branch_points_in_effectful_modules (10 / 1 / 10) and on declared_interfaces (0 / 1 / 0), while D2 scores all three identically at 2 -- as it has on 27 of 27 cards ever written about this example. THE THREE GOALS. GOAL-instruments-can-fail MISSED on its only target ("nothing is silently omitted"); GOAL-scorecard-carries-a-delta MISSED on D4 and D5; GOAL-fixture-can-diverge MET, narrowly. Baseline, measured, target and verdict with a reason for each are in RESULTS.md and in the per-goal files. FINDINGS BY CHANNEL, 0 : 16 : 1 : 1 : 12 over the whole epic -- thirty findings, ZERO from the suite, which was green throughout while three instruments were missing from the enumeration and one shipped validator was red on the repository's own model. NOTHING WAS FIXED.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, AND THE REASON IS THE MEASUREMENT RULE. FI-06 is the epic's evaluation ticket: its whole product is a report, and its standing instruction is FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING. Every refinement this ticket could have proposed is a change to an instrument it is measuring with, so applying one would move a number during the report that number is in. Twelve candidates were found and every one was FILED rather than refined: FI-06-DF-01 (eight instruments absent from the registry -- registering run_arm_swap.py is four lines and would have turned 26-of-35 into 27-of-36, which is the number-fitting the rule exists to forbid), FI-06-DF-02 (the twelve pytest slots with no expect_output), FI-06-DF-03 (two slots with no seeded break), and nine more. Each carries a suggested_fix for whoever owns the next round.

ticket.objective: The epic's product and a MEASUREMENT, not a victory lap. A low or unflattering result is the preferred outcome. Report: the count of instruments that cannot be shown to fail; the scorecard's cross-round movement against its 4-point baseline; whether the fixture's arms can diverge at all; and whether anything we generate beats a hand-written suite yet. THREE EPICS SAY NO AND THE LAST ONE SHOWED suite-fake STRICTLY DOMINATING EVERY GENERATED COLUMN. If that is still true, it is the headline and it is reported as the headline rather than buried under the parts that improved. Findings BY CHANNEL with the ratio stated as a result. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING.
